tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'
# Wire format

No decision on the wire serialisation format is currently recorded for this project, so no format is specified here. This document will be updated once a decision is recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/wire-format.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says that no wire serialisation format decision is currently recorded, so no format is specified.

I searched the project's recorded decisions with `muninn why`, using the terms serialisation, protobuf, JSON, msgpack, encoding and wire protocol. None of the results was about wire format. The recorded decisions I did find cover other subjects: zstd compression, argon2id hashing, semver, Apache-2.0, https enforcement and LRU caching. The only wire-format-related hits were in `docs/doc.md`, which lists the rendering formats Gin supports (JSON, XML, YAML, TOML, ProtoBuf, MsgPack). That is documentation of features, not a project decision, so I did not use it.
